FE_role: Nominal rebuild of preserved shell element source; historical tuned full-precision state is unavailable.
extension: Minimum K0 energy subject to full-FE registered anchors; no added rigid-pattern correction.
fields: Constrained nominal elastic-energy modes of the represented translations after full-FE static relaxation of x translations and rotations. Use diagonal represented FE translational inertia to order fields; orthonormalize in full M0 afterward.
selection_rule: Minimize unregularized full-FE equation imbalance with exact fixed port columns and a hard all-r-direction represented singular-value margin. Retain the best physically feasible candidate; no excluded response selects parameters, space, threshold or stopping.
mass_normalization: No exact prescribed-M0 constraint; report the actual projected FE mass and stiffness and their corrections.
spring_prior: Deterministic imperfect nominal grounded chain; same topology and essential constraints as the generating system. M0,K0 enter only post-fit completion. C0 defines the nominal baseline FRF and is excluded from the completion criterion.

spring_nominal.selection: One specified perturbation; no response-based search or tuning. Physical order is masses 1,2,3; anchor order is force endpoint 1 then response endpoint 3.

rank_solver.initialization: Archived feasible regularized completion mapped into the same physical affine family; equality-only solution is also a candidate.
rank_solver.reason: Unconstrained FE residual minimization does not enforce an independent displacement basis.

admissible_space: Full FE fields satisfying K_oo u_o + K_oy u_y=0; R H=I; no omitted coordinate is clamped. Both mechanical energies use H-expanded full fields.
